trainingVisible.use: schema, formula-language, and natural-language development only
trainingVisible.limitation: The pinned v0.0 train records do not contain conclusion-FOL, so they are not scored by the official-formula baseline.

development.oracle: The adapter returns a label-free pool. Labels are read only inside the host scorer and are not returned by loadFolioDevelopmentPool.

fresh.reason: The official pinned v0.0 README states that the test set is unreleased. Both locally labeled files are development-visible, so reserving either after inspection would not create untouched evidence.

codingAgent: No Coding Agent is used by source validation, formula adaptation, direct-language coverage, or scoring. Development labels must not enter synthesis packets.
